rows.jyutping: dat6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 bou6 fan6
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for a part that sticks out.

example.english: There’s a protrusion on the edge of the table that I keep bumping my foot against.
example.traditional: 張枱邊有一嚿凸出嚟嘅部分，成日撞親我隻腳。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 bin1 jau5 jat1 gau6 dat6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 bou6 fan6 seng4 jat6 zong6 can1 ngo5 zek3 goek3

rows.note: Use this for a distinct raised or sticking-out spot, especially on an object or surface.

example.english: Watch out for that protrusion on the floor, or you could easily trip over it.
example.traditional: 小心地下嗰個凸位，行過嗰陣好易絆親。
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 dei2 haa6 go2 go3 dat6 wai6 haang4 gwo3 go2 zan6 hou2 ji6 bun6 can1
